supplies.q: Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
supplies.a: Agree cleaning products and equipment with us before the visit. Tell us if you prefer your own products.

keys.a: We offer flexible options: you can be home to let us in, leave a key with a neighbour or concierge, or use a key lockbox. Many of our regular clients provide us with a key after building trust.

cancellation.a: Contact us promptly to cancel or reschedule. See our booking and cancellation terms. Your statutory consumer rights are not affected.

pets.a: Please discuss pets and any product restrictions before the visit. Product suitability depends on the specific product and circumstances.

duration.q: How long does a cleaning take?
duration.a: A standard home cleaning (55–85 m²) typically takes 2–3 hours. Deep cleans take longer (3–5 hours). We'll confirm the estimated time in your WhatsApp quote.

frequency.a: Contact us to discuss recurring cleaning and available dates. The scope, frequency and price are agreed separately.

sections.p: ReadySetSiivous, business ID 3404861-9. For privacy enquiries and requests, email info@readysetsiivous.fi or call +358 46 804 4231.

Quote enquiries, bookings and customer service may include your name, contact details, cleaning address, service, dates and messages. Bookings are saved in our service systems. We use these details to respond to enquiries, arrange and deliver services and handle related administration. Avoid including access codes, health details or other sensitive information in free-text fields.

Information needed to respond to your request or provide a service is processed for pre-contractual steps or performance of a contract. Statutory records are processed to meet legal obligations. Necessary security and dispute handling may rely on legitimate interests. Optional marketing, if offered, requires a separate appropriate basis; booking is not consent to marketing.

Our hosting, storage, authentication and email providers may process information needed to run the service. WhatsApp is an external service: a quote form opens a draft and you choose whether to send it there. Contact us for information about applicable recipients and international-transfer arrangements.

Information is retained while needed for the enquiry, service, legal record-keeping or establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims; unnecessary information should be erased or anonymised. You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability and object where applicable by contacting info@readysetsiivous.fi. We normally respond within one month. Erasure is subject to applicable retention obligations and other legal exceptions. You may complain to the Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi).

No advertising or analytics tools are included in this public website code. Your explicitly selected language or theme may be saved in your browser. Authentication and security functions may use storage necessary to provide the requested service. The public fonts and contact QR images are hosted with this site. External links are governed by the external service provider’s practices.
ReadySetSiivous, business ID 3404861-9. Contact info@readysetsiivous.fi or +358 46 804 4231 about quotes, bookings, cancellations or complaints.

Submitting this website’s booking form sends a request pending confirmation. We contact you to agree the service scope, price, time and access arrangements. A WhatsApp draft is not sent until you send it in WhatsApp. Any additional work or charges must be agreed before proceeding.

Consumer prices shown for online service requests include VAT and apply per selected service, not automatically per hour. The agreed service scope and duration determine what is included. We confirm payment arrangements and any separately agreed additional charges before a binding service agreement. Statutory consumer rights take precedence.

Contact us as soon as possible to cancel or reschedule. You may use the booking management page with your booking number and private key, or contact us by email or phone. A contractual cancellation policy does not replace statutory withdrawal rights. Any applicable charge must have a lawful and previously disclosed basis.

For consumer distance service contracts, a statutory 14-day withdrawal period generally starts when the contract is concluded. If you expressly request performance during that period, proportionate payment may be due for work already performed. Loss of the withdrawal right after full performance requires the legally required request and acknowledgment. Where withdrawal requires a refund, it is generally due within 14 days of notice, subject to lawful deductions. Contact us or use booking management; keep your cancellation acknowledgement.

Tell us promptly about any defect or concern, with the booking details. Applicable statutory remedies remain available; these terms do not exclude mandatory liability. Consumers may contact Finnish Consumer Advisory Services (kkv.fi) and the Consumer Disputes Board (kuluttajariita.fi). Finnish law applies without removing mandatory consumer protection.
